description: The finite Boolean normalizer computes positive or negative disjunctive normal form as a list of lists of literals; the empty clause means truth and the empty clause list means falsity.
signature:
Lemmatheca.ComputabilityTheory.EffectiveQuantifierElimination.normalForm {o : Bool} {n : ℕ} :
  Lemmatheca.ComputabilityTheory.EffectiveQuantifierElimination.RelFormula o n →
    Bool → Lemmatheca.ComputabilityTheory.EffectiveQuantifierElimination.DNF o n
